value.doc: One record in the Outflows-Deposits table. `maturityAmount` is the balance in USD.

The Outflows-Deposits products in scope:

  - O.D.1: Transactional Accounts
  - O.D.2: Non-Transactional Relationship Accounts
  - O.D.3: Non-Transactional Non-Relationship Accounts
  - O.D.14: Other Third-Party Deposits
  - O.D.15: Other Accounts
FR 2052a data table O.D: Outflows-Deposits, limited to the retail products in scope.
The FR 2052a counterparty types, in the order the instructions list them.

Retail (a natural person) or Small Business (an entity managed as a retail exposure):
the counterparties every LCR retail outflow rule, (10) to (14), applies to.

FR 2052a field definition: Counterparty. The type of legal counterparty to an exposure
(not its ultimate parent).
Whether a deposit balance is fully insured, and by whom.

Fully insured by the FDIC. Rules (10) and (12) require it; "Other" (fully insured by a
non-US government scheme) counts as "Not FDIC".

FR 2052a field definition: Insured. Whether a deposit balance is fully covered by
government deposit insurance.
The LCR rule a deposit falls under.
The deposit is reported under O.D.14: Other Third-Party Deposits.
Stressed outflow for one deposit: balance times its rule's run-off rate, to the cent.

Overview: which of rules (10) to (14) a deposit falls under, checked in Appendix VI order.
A deposit from a counterparty other than Retail or Small Business falls under none of them.

(10) Stable Retail Deposits (§.32(a)(1)): O.D.1 and O.D.2, Retail or Small Business,
FDIC insured.

(11) Other Retail Deposits (§.32(a)(2)): O.D.1 and O.D.2 that are not FDIC insured, and
all O.D.3, from Retail or Small Business.

(12) Insured Placed Retail Deposits (§.32(a)(3)): O.D.14, Retail or Small Business, FDIC
insured.

(13) Non-Insured Placed Retail Deposits (§.32(a)(4)): O.D.14, Retail or Small Business,
not FDIC insured.
(14) Other Retail Funding (§.32(a)(5)): O.D.15, Retail or Small Business.

Run-off rate for each rule, as a fraction of the balance. The FR 2052a instructions do
not state rates; these are the SME's answer, from 12 CFR 249.32(a). Deposits outside rules
(10) to (14) are mapped by later rules not in scope, so no outflow is computed for them here.
Total stressed retail deposit outflows across all records.
LCR outflow rules (10) to (14) of Appendix VI, applied to Outflows-Deposits records.
